d: In the politically crucial regions of West Champaran and East Champaran, there are a total of 21 Assembly seats, and the BJP has continued its traditional dominance here. This election once again reinforced the party’s stronghold, with the NDA winning most of the seats. Out of 21, the BJP secured 15 seats, JDU won 3, and LJP (Ramvilas) bagged 2 seats.In the previous election too, the BJP held a commanding position with victories on 15 seats, while JDU won 2 and RJD claimed 3 — giving the NDA a total of 17 out of 21 seats.
